_rule: Prepared BEFORE any run (AGENTS.md), 2026-11-15, branch claude/roof-moving-shadow. STAGED, not queued, not authorized.
question: Does rt_sun_roof_world=1 (whole-level roof selection from a fixed origin, docs/TRACK_D_SUN.md 12.5) stop the sun shadow that moves over a still character under the port roofs, without changing the mean brightness or the GPU cost?
evidence: User screens docs/dialogue_user_screens/7-9.webp (Test Dialogue3, 2026-11-03): a dark band moves over the left character in bright sun. Code: key off, core/sun_trust.cpp re-reads the roof volumes around the delayed camera every 30 frames or 5 m with a radius read back from the screen (farthest roof-tested pixel + rt_tmax), against unpadded bounds, while shaders/gi/sun_roof.hlsli tests padded boxes on an infinite ray: the uploaded set can change under a still receiver. Offline: sun_roof_selection_test (1216 checks), assetdb_test (CTY records identical across a camera cut).
design: One launch, Test Dialogue3 (loads in dialogue, static shot), Ultra, FG 3x, visible_unfocused_fg. States off-a / on / off-b, the key toggled live. Per state one static window of two complete 600-frame sun stats periods, then a static energy window (exposure held, 4 float traces 5 s apart with PNG previews). rt_shadows=1, rt_sun_replace=1, rt_sun_roofs=1, rt_sun_roof_mode=0, pad 3, up 50, radius 0 and rt_cascade_casters=1 are set explicitly.
noise_rule: Every threshold is the OFF repeat of the same run: noise(metric) = |off-b - off-a|. Floors are tools/live_batches/sane_gates.py's (energy 0.5%, cost max(0.1 ms, 1%)). Frame time and FG presentation are not judged from an occluded window.

predicted.selection: ON: one 'sun: world roof selection: level CTY_Main_A, N volumes (N uploaded)' line per enable with N = the level's total (398 at CTY, scripts/roof_stats.py), and every sun stats line shows N roof volumes and 'roof query -1 m'. OFF: 'roof query R m' with R > 0 and a roof volume count <= N that may differ between lines.
predicted.band: If the changing roof set caused the band: the 4 PNGs of the ON energy window show no band movement on the left character (block luminance of the chest within the OFF pair's static-area noise), and both OFF windows reproduce it (0.073 block luminance in the 03:09 ds3 run of 2026-11-03). If the band persists with the key on while the roof set is fixed: rejected as the band fix (the cause is then the native mask kept under roofs in mode 0, or the cascade casters), key stays off.
predicted.roof_share: sun stats 'px under roofs' and 'kept by roofs': ON >= OFF (the whole level can only add volumes). A rise above the OFF pair's spread is the membership the legacy query missed; equal values with a still band also reject the key as the fix.
predicted.energy: Normalized scene colour mean ON inside the OFF samples' range or within 0.5% of the OFF mean. More roofs keep more of the game's shadow under roofs, so a physically correct ON may be darker under roofs only: a whole-frame loss beyond the floor is reported with the 'kept by roofs' delta, not passed silently.
predicted.cost: rt passes GPU ms ON - OFF within noise + max(0.1 ms, 1%). The roof loop of rt_sun_resolve runs over N volumes instead of the local subset: predicted +0.00 to +0.10 ms at 398 volumes, unmeasured so far. CPU: one query per level instead of one per 30 frames.
predicted.faults: 0: no crash, no device loss, 'over kSunMaxVolumes on 0 frames' in every sun stats line of every state.

decision: Key to default 1 only if the band stops in ON and returns in both OFF windows, energy and cost hold, and a cut-away interior in real Ultra keeps its roof protection (a second scene, not in this job). Band still there with a fixed roof set: key stays 0, record it in TRACK_D_SUN 12.5.
not_measured_here: Roof modes 1 and 2, a camera pan (the dialogue shot is static), other levels' volume counts (the offline cap gate covers them).
